clue.text: Resolute person breaks law in the beginning

indicators.note: the jumbled word is placed within the word for beginning

parts.note: the start is the beginning

indicators.note: the word law is broken up, so its three letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A determined figure breaks the law right at the outset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Resolute person' is the definition; 'breaks' is the anagram signal, not a verb acting on the law in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A stalwart is a loyal, steadfast supporter, a person firm in resolve.

clue.text: Thanks Scotsman for including successful record by an islander

indicators.note: the thanks and the Scotsman together take a further piece within them

parts.note: ta is informal British for thanks
Ian is a typical Scottish man's name
a hit is a successful record in the charts

explanation.surface: Someone thanks a Scot for adding a chart-topping record by an island musician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by an' is link material; the islander comes from Tahiti in French Polynesia.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Tahiti in French Polynesia is a South Sea island dweller.

clue.text: Electric vans not causing congestion?

definitions.meaning: vehicles powered by electricity, read whimsically as traffic of the electric-light kind
few vehicles on the road, so no jams

explanation.surface: Battery-powered vans keep the roads clear.
explanation.definitionFit: Sparse road use leaves streets free of jams; electric vehicles playfully read as traffic in illumination.

clue.text: Moor reportedly going over a place in Turkey

indicators.note: the word for moor is heard as it would be spoken

parts.note: to moor a boat is to anchor it

explanation.surface: A Moor is said to be travelling across to a spot in Turkey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Moor' looks like a North African; here it is the verb, to anchor a ship, said aloud as ANKAR, with A added.
explanation.definitionFit: The Turkish capital city is a place in Turkey.

clue.text: Sound of a wrong note

indicators.note: the word note is put wrong, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A musician hears the sound of a bum note.
explanation.definitionFit: A tone is a musical sound of definite pitch.

clue.text: Let down with a puncture during the performance

indicators.note: one piece occurs in the middle of the other

parts.note: a deed is something performed, an act
a flat is a punctured tyre

explanation.surface: Disappointed when a tyre burst during the show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Let down' works twice in the surface: a disappointed audience, and a tyre losing air.
explanation.definitionFit: Let down means deflated, as of a tyre losing air or a person losing spirit.

clue.text: Record no short time in the lead

indicators.note: the short time goes in front of the other word

parts.note: mo is short for moment

explanation.surface: A record that held no lead for even a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: A monaural recording, single-channel, is a mono record.

clue.text: Resisted change made by newswoman

indicators.note: the letters of the first word are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A female journalist fought off reform.
explanation.definitionFit: An old word for a female editor, a woman in charge of a newspaper.

clue.text: Put on too much weight

parts.note: reads as gaining excess pounds, but means placing an excessive burden or load on something

explanation.surface: Someone has piled on the pounds.
explanation.definitionFit: To burden something beyond capacity is to place excessive weight on it.

clue.text: Sounds as if it might have covered the head of an old politician

indicators.note: what is heard matches a word spelt differently

parts.words: it might have covered the head
parts.note: a wig covers the head

explanation.surface: Something seems to have once topped an old statesman's head.
explanation.walkthrough: Whigs were a historic British political party, forerunners of the Liberals.
explanation.definitionFit: A Whig belonged to the historic British party later succeeded by the Liberals.

clue.text: Very many angels or just St Peter?

definitions.meaning: a great multitude of angelic beings
the saint at heaven's gate, playfully the one receiving guests there

explanation.surface: A multitude of angels, or only the gatekeeper saint?
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical phrase for the angelic throng; St Peter jokingly welcomes visitors to paradise.

clue.text: Where one might go to get rid of ill-feelings

definitions.text: Where one might go to get rid of ill-feelings

parts.words: Where one might go to get rid of ill-feelings
parts.note: ill-feelings reads as resentment, but means feeling unwell, cured at a spa

explanation.surface: A place to go to shake off grudges.
explanation.definitionFit: A spa town is visited to recover from sickness.

clue.text: Girl's characteristic is that she is absent-minded

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, here with its possessive
a trait is a characteristic

explanation.surface: A girl's defining quality is her forgetfulness.
explanation.definitionFit: Distrait describes someone distracted, inattentive through worry.

clue.text: Oil shortly to spurt out

indicators.note: the letters of the word are put out of order

explanation.surface: Oil is about to gush out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shortly' belongs to the definition: the answer is the short form of turpentine.
explanation.definitionFit: A colloquial abbreviation of turpentine, an oil used as a solvent.

clue.text: Canter around in a dazed condition

indicators.note: the letters are moved around into a new order

explanation.surface: A rider ambles in a daze.
explanation.definitionFit: A trance is a stupor, a half-conscious state.

clue.text: There is nothing in two different articles about an ox

indicators.note: the zero is placed inside the pair of articles

parts.note: an is the indefinite article before a vowel
a is the other form of the indefinite article
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: An essay on oxen with nothing of substance.
explanation.walkthrough: The anoa is a small buffalo of Sulawesi.
explanation.definitionFit: The anoa is a dwarf buffalo of Indonesia, a wild bovine.

clue.text: Room for Jumbo maybe overhead

parts.note: Jumbo suggests an elephant, but means a jumbo jet, which needs space up in the sky

explanation.surface: Space up above for an elephant.
explanation.definitionFit: The region of sky above a country, where jets fly, is space in the air.

clue.text: Disheartened?

parts.note: reads as dispirited, but means having the heart or centre removed, as with an apple

explanation.definitionFit: An apple with its central part taken out has lost its heart.

clue.text: Officer to slip and fall

parts.note: Col is short for colonel, an officer
a lapse is a slip

explanation.surface: An officer is about to slip and tumble.
explanation.definitionFit: To collapse is to fall down suddenly.

clue.text: Girl taking only half of the mosaic pieces

indicators.note: only the first half of the word for mosaic pieces is kept

parts.note: tesserae are the small tiles of a mosaic

explanation.surface: A girl helps herself to half the tiles.
explanation.definitionFit: Tess is a girl's name, as in Hardy's novel.

clue.text: One who drives furiously when the car melts

definitions.meaning: someone who drives very fast, scorching along

explanation.surface: A speed demon whose car melts in the heat.
explanation.definitionFit: A reckless fast driver; also a very hot day, hot enough to melt.

clue.text: Sorry the French way was not quite complete

parts.note: rue is French for street, a way

indicators.note: the last letter of the word for complete is dropped

parts.note: full means complete

explanation.surface: Regretful that the French route was unfinished.
explanation.definitionFit: Rueful means regretful, expressing sorrow.

clue.text: Lots go here despite rising prices

definitions.text: Lots go here despite rising prices

parts.words: Lots go here despite rising prices
parts.note: lots suggests a great many people, but means auction lots, sold as bids go up

explanation.surface: Crowds flock in even as costs climb.
explanation.definitionFit: An auction house sells lots to escalating bids.

clue.text: Chance to watch television

explanation.surface: An opportunity to sit and view TV.
explanation.definitionFit: Colloquially an opportunity to join in; also literally viewing a broadcast.

clue.text: Gambling on the ship's movement

definitions.meaning: a game of tossing coins at a mark
a vessel heaving front to back and side to side

explanation.surface: Betting aboard a rolling vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A coin-throwing game; and a vessel's pitching and tossing at sea.

clue.text: Bitter sweet

explanation.surface: Something bittersweet.
explanation.definitionFit: Sour-tasting; also a pastry pudding with fruit filling.

clue.text: Chump left Dorothy outside

indicators.note: the name stands outside the other piece

parts.note: Dot is short for Dorothy

explanation.surface: A fool deserted by Dorothy.
explanation.definitionFit: A dolt is a stupid person, a fool.

clue.text: Some hothouse creature from Germany!

indicators.note: part of the word is taken as the answer

explanation.surface: A creature from Germany lives in a hothouse.
explanation.definitionFit: Otho is a German name, borne by a person from that country.

clue.text: Girl goes round America in a drunken feast

indicators.note: the girl's name surrounds the other piece

parts.note: Carol is a girl's name
America gives USA

explanation.surface: A girl tours America on a boozy binge.
explanation.definitionFit: A carousal is a drinking party, a riotous revel.

clue.text: Shady medicinal concoction?

parts.note: shady suggests dubious, but points to a tint or shade of colour, and to an alcoholic medicine solution

explanation.surface: A dodgy potion.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a slight colouring and an alcohol-based medical solution.
